task.description:
Design for REQ-070 (two invented tenants of the form /3 for the new office stand — "Складеон" id stock and "Лидвейв" id agency — full files in three languages, answer sets, tests). This is mostly DATA, so keep the design short and exact. Read first: the block REQ-070 in docs/requirements.yaml (all six criteria are binding), the block REQ-069 (now done) and docs/design/REQ-069-tenant-look-format.md (what the check enforces: sections 6.x rules, M01-M37 messages, the colour rule, sheets #f3f5f9 and #161f2e), decisions 0083, 0084, 0085, 0066, 0070, 0071, 0072, 0076, the approved sample docs/design/samples/picker-v3-approved-2026-10-26/ (data.js: STOCK and AGENCY), the existing demo tenants tools/src/picker/demo-tenants and demo-answers and their tests (picker-demo*.test.js and the helpers), tools/test/fixtures/picker-look/ (samples of /3 that already pass), the engine REQ-055 (tools/src/picker/engine.js, computeResult) and its tests, tools/README.md.
Produce docs/design/REQ-070-demo-tenants-v3.md (English, decisions/0080): files to create with exact paths (tools/src/picker/demo-tenants-v3/stock.json and agency.json, demo-answers-v3/stock.json and agency.json, tools/test/picker-demo-v3.test.js, helpers if any); the path map from sample data.js fields to the tenant file fields (a table); how each of the six criteria becomes a test (criterion to test table with ids and files; oracles independent of code: own contrast function, literals, the sample module loaded with a substituted window); the exact choices left to the executor and the rule for each: the two replacement colours (state the method: same hue, change only lightness, the nearest passing step; the test checks the rule, not the value), the digits where the sample is silent, the invented phone numbers; the table of text edits (at most six rows: was, became, reason as a check error code) — decide NOW from the sample which ru texts do not pass the check (length of a phrase, forbidden signs, the mark "?" of the option "Пока нигде" which loses its tag) by running the real check command on a sketch outside the project (use the session scratchpad folder named in the launching message); the answer sets leader/close/none/half and how the engine result for each is verified (state the expected labels from a real run of the engine on the sketch, not by guess); which of the existing guard tests count files of demo-tenants or list all picker folders and need a was-to-became row (run the old tests with the new files placed in a copy and report which turn red); mutants for the new data tests (a colour at 2.99:1, a count in the intro changed, a text copied from one tenant into the other, a half set with three answers, a leader that turns into close, etc.), the failure paths with unchanged state, sub-steps for BACKEND-DEV (data first, then tests), the questions for ORCH (plain). Design only; no implementation code in the design; the sketches stay outside the project. The look of the reference products is not your task; do not mention any other project in files. No machine paths and no project names in the handoff text (say "the traces list"). 16 GB RAM computer: single commands.

issues.text: Criterion 2 says each reason in the table of edits is a code of the check, but two roles of agency (desk 1 and desk 4, all three languages) are equal to the roles of stock in the sample and criterion 4 forbids shared texts. The design rewrites the roles of the second tenant (rows E2, E3) and uses the reason SEP (criterion 4). Proposal for a decisions/ record: 'in REQ-070 an edit reason is a check code or SEP'. Alternative: a micro-amendment of criterion 2. Default stands in the design.

The block REQ-070 has seven criteria; the handoff says six. The design covers seven. Also the handoff names tests picker-demo*.test.js that do not exist (the demo tenants are read through helpers in picker-helpers.js and picker-engine-helpers.js); the new test file is picker-demo-v3.test.js.

Who writes tools/test/picker-demo-v3.test.js: WF-02 gives tests to TEST-DESIGNER (step 5); the task says data first, then tests for BACKEND-DEV. The design follows WF-02; the catalogue is the same either way.

figure ids: the sample draws people by skin, hair and style, /3 has twelve ids drawn later by REQ-071. The design fixes f01-f04 (stock) and f05-f08 (agency). A different mapping is a one-line edit of the data and of DT-1b.

All kk texts of the two files, including the new solution, rule and lead texts and the rewritten roles of rows E2 and E3, are drafts; the reader of criterion 5 reads them, the owner does not wait for a native check (decision 0072 item 2).
